question.text: An option has vega = 0.02, premium Rs. 0.10, implied volatility 10%. If volatility increases by 2% to 12%, what is the new premium?

explanation.text: The Logic: Change = Vega x Vol change = 0.02 x 2 = 0.04. New premium = 0.10 + 0.04 = Rs. 0.14. The Trap: Rs. 0.12 assumes only 1% change. Question says 2%. Cross-Exam Context: Vega calcs tested in Series I and VIII.
